nuggets.text: The Mountaineers retired record-setting quarterback Pat White's No. 5 jersey at last week's opener against Coastal Carolina.
Rhett Rodriguez, son of head coach Rich Rodriguez, coaches the Mountaineers' quarterbacks, with Pat White as an assistant.
The Mountaineers' first game, in 1891, was a 72-0 loss to Washington & Jefferson on a converted cow pasture.
Rich Rodriguez, a Grant Town, West Virginia, native and a 1986 WVU graduate, is in his ninth season leading the Mountaineers.
Cam Cook led the nation with 1,659 rushing yards at Jacksonville State last season, then ran for 142 in his Mountaineers debut.
The Mountaineers' 122-player roster hails from 31 states and four other countries, including England and Ireland.
The buckskin-clad Mountaineer mascot leads the team onto the field every game, firing a rifle into the air.
Rich Rodriguez entered 2026 with 194 career wins, third among active Power Four head coaches.
The Mountaineers are chasing their first 2-0 start since 2018.
Michael Hawkins Jr., an Oklahoma transfer, ran for 103 yards on 20 carries in his Mountaineers debut.
